tools.name: check_mold_layout
tools.description:
Check whether molds fit together on a rotational-molding machine arm.

        Every answer comes from the deterministic RotoSpider geometric layout
        engine: rotation-envelope and dead-height checks, pairwise mold-to-mold
        clearance, offset-arm riser selection, and ring arrangements fo

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description:
Relay a user question, bug report, or suggestion to the maintainers.

        Args:
            message: The user's feedback text (required).
            contact: Optional reply address the user volunteers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_mold_layout" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
